first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for an Exeter building on the City Council Local List, directly bound to explicit building identity/type-use evidence. The official Buildings of local importance page confirms the Local List, explains the selection criteria including distinctive or special building types/styles, and points to Schedule 5, but this source window publishes no record-level polygon coordinates or downloadable building geometry. Source-area metadata was inspected without parcel-progress credit and no individual building record was accepted.
